package com.mukasanches.zapptv.model

enum class ChannelSource {
    NATIVE_TUNER,
    NATIVE_TV_APP,
    HLS,
    IPTV,
    WEB
}

data class Channel(
    val id: String,
    val number: String,
    val name: String,
    val source: ChannelSource,
    val canonicalId: String? = null,
    val category: String = "TV",
    val uri: String? = null,
    val nativeInputId: String? = null,
    val nativeChannelId: Long? = null,
    val packageName: String? = null,
    val epgId: String? = null,
    val logoUri: String? = null
)

package com.mukasanches.zapptv.model

data class TvCapabilityProfile(
    val manufacturer: String,
    val model: String,
    val androidApi: Int,
    val fingerprint: String,
    val isTcl: Boolean,
    val tvInputs: List<TvInputSummary>,
    val tunerCount: Int,
    val hdmiCount: Int,
    val nativeTvPackage: String?
)

data class TvInputSummary(
    val id: String,
    val label: String,
    val type: Int,
    val state: Int,
    val packageName: String?,
    val passthrough: Boolean
)

package com.mukasanches.zapptv.nativebridge

import android.content.Context
import android.media.tv.TvContract
import com.mukasanches.zapptv.data.ChannelResolver
import com.mukasanches.zapptv.model.Channel
import com.mukasanches.zapptv.model.ChannelSource
import com.mukasanches.zapptv.model.ProgramInfo

class NativeChannelReader(private val context: Context) {

    fun readChannels(tunerInputIds: Set<String>): List<Channel> {
        if (tunerInputIds.isEmpty()) return emptyList()

        val projection = arrayOf(
            TvContract.Channels._ID,
            TvContract.Channels.COLUMN_DISPLAY_NUMBER,
            TvContract.Channels.COLUMN_DISPLAY_NAME,
            TvContract.Channels.COLUMN_INPUT_ID,
            TvContract.Channels.COLUMN_BROWSABLE
        )

        return runCatching {
            val channels = mutableListOf<Channel>()
            context.contentResolver.query(
                TvContract.Channels.CONTENT_URI,
                projection,
                null,
                null,
                null
            )?.use { cursor ->
                val idIndex = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(TvContract.Channels._ID)
                val numberIndex = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(TvContract.Channels.COLUMN_DISPLAY_NUMBER)
                val nameIndex = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(TvContract.Channels.COLUMN_DISPLAY_NAME)
                val inputIndex = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(TvContract.Channels.COLUMN_INPUT_ID)
                val browsableIndex = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(TvContract.Channels.COLUMN_BROWSABLE)

                while (cursor.moveToNext()) {
                    val inputId = cursor.getString(inputIndex) ?: continue
                    if (inputId !in tunerInputIds) continue
                    if (cursor.getInt(browsableIndex) == 0) continue

                    val nativeId = cursor.getLong(idIndex)
                    val name = cursor.getString(nameIndex)?.ifBlank { null } ?: "Canal"
                    val number = cursor.getString(numberIndex).orEmpty()

                    channels += Channel(
                        id = "native:$nativeId",
                        number = number,
                        name = name,
                        source = ChannelSource.NATIVE_TUNER,
                        canonicalId = ChannelResolver.canonicalId(name),
                        category = "TV aberta",
                        uri = TvContract.buildChannelUri(nativeId).toString(),
                        nativeInputId = inputId,
                        nativeChannelId = nativeId
                    )
                }
            }
            channels.sortedWith(compareBy({ channelNumberKey(it.number) }, { it.name }))
        }.getOrElse { emptyList() }
    }

    fun readCurrentPrograms(channels: List<Channel>): Map<String, ProgramInfo> {
        val byNativeId = channels
            .filter { it.nativeChannelId != null }
            .associateBy { it.nativeChannelId!! }
        if (byNativeId.isEmpty()) return emptyMap()

        val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
        val projection = arrayOf(
            TvContract.Programs.COLUMN_CHANNEL_ID,
            TvContract.Programs.COLUMN_TITLE,
            TvContract.Programs.COLUMN_EPISODE_TITLE,
            TvContract.Programs.COLUMN_SHORT_DESCRIPTION,
            TvContract.Programs.COLUMN_START_TIME_UTC_MILLIS,
            TvContract.Programs.COLUMN_END_TIME_UTC_MILLIS
        )

        return runCatching {
            val result = mutableMapOf<String, ProgramInfo>()
            val selection =
                TvContract.Programs.COLUMN_START_TIME_UTC_MILLIS + " <= ? AND " +
                    TvContract.Programs.COLUMN_END_TIME_UTC_MILLIS + " > ?"

            context.contentResolver.query(
                TvContract.Programs.CONTENT_URI,
                projection,
                selection,
                arrayOf(now.toString(), now.toString()),
                null
            )?.use { cursor ->
                val channelIndex = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(TvContract.Programs.COLUMN_CHANNEL_ID)
                val titleIndex = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(TvContract.Programs.COLUMN_TITLE)
                val episodeIndex = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(TvContract.Programs.COLUMN_EPISODE_TITLE)
                val descriptionIndex = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(TvContract.Programs.COLUMN_SHORT_DESCRIPTION)
                val startIndex = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(TvContract.Programs.COLUMN_START_TIME_UTC_MILLIS)
                val endIndex = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(TvContract.Programs.COLUMN_END_TIME_UTC_MILLIS)

                while (cursor.moveToNext()) {
                    val nativeId = cursor.getLong(channelIndex)
                    val channel = byNativeId[nativeId] ?: continue
                    result[channel.id] = ProgramInfo(
                        channelId = channel.id,
                        title = cursor.getString(titleIndex)?.ifBlank { null } ?: "Ao vivo",
                        subtitle = cursor.getString(episodeIndex),
                        description = cursor.getString(descriptionIndex),
                        startMillis = cursor.getLong(startIndex),
                        endMillis = cursor.getLong(endIndex)
                    )
                }
            }
            result
        }.getOrElse { emptyMap() }
    }

    private fun channelNumberKey(number: String): Double {
        val normalized = number.replace(',', '.')
        return normalized.toDoubleOrNull()
            ?: Regex("\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?").find(normalized)?.value?.toDoubleOrNull()
            ?: Double.MAX_VALUE
    }
}

package com.mukasanches.zapptv.nativebridge

/**
 * TCL-specific boundary.
 *
 * V1 intentionally starts from public Android TV APIs. Any model-specific behavior must
 * be proven on hardware before it is added here, keeping the rest of the app OEM-agnostic.
 */
class TclTvAdapter : GenericTvAdapter()

package com.mukasanches.zapptv.ui

import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme
import androidx.compose.material3.darkColorScheme
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color

object ZappColors {
    val Background = Color(0xFF07090D)
    val Surface = Color(0xE61A1E25)
    val SurfaceStrong = Color(0xFF20252E)
    val Focus = Color(0xFFF2F5F8)
    val FocusText = Color(0xFF101318)
    val PrimaryText = Color(0xFFF5F7FA)
    val SecondaryText = Color(0xFFADB5C0)
    val Muted = Color(0xFF737D8C)
    val Accent = Color(0xFF7EC8FF)
    val Progress = Color(0xFFDDE6EF)
}

@Composable
fun ZappTheme(content: @Composable () -> Unit) {
    MaterialTheme(
        colorScheme = darkColorScheme(
            primary = ZappColors.Accent,
            background = ZappColors.Background,
            surface = ZappColors.SurfaceStrong,
            onBackground = ZappColors.PrimaryText,
            onSurface = ZappColors.PrimaryText
        ),
        content = content
    )
}
